svg.title: Caveman architecture and complete component inventory
svg.text: Pinned upstream • 125 records • conditional paths • local evidence is separate from runtime proof
Host executes tools under its approvals
Finite stdout, logs and tool results
Tool calls stay owned by the host
Catalog Shrink paths are distinct from output Shrink
Owns agent loop, approvals, tools and history
Compact tool text is not exact evidence
Configured local route; execution proof separate
Returns model result and tool intent
Host decides and executes tool calls
Actions and JavaScript can change site state
Retrieve full source for exact conclusions
Hooks and native plugins deliver policy
Presence does not prove event delivery
Stats reads proxy usage; savings unknown
Receives copied outbound request from host
Framework keeps history and inference ownership
Selected route still reaches a model provider
Learn report, SQLite observations and state
Proxy usage / cache hints → local stats
No user history scanned for this diagram
Device auth + project-scoped control / read MCP
Authenticated metadata sync omits raw bodies
Control is separate from hosted inference
Blue: inference / host loop Teal: compression / recovery Purple: policy / events Amber: tools / excluded options
Dashed = explicitly selected or conditional. Configured / available ≠ activated. Excluded badges describe local policy.
125 exact source names below. This map draws selected important edges, not all 207 inventory relations.
• Lifecycle hooks and native event adapter
• Provider network and local trust guards
• Feature config and proxy YAML control
• Recommend, shadow, canary and active modes
• Legacy JS caveman-shrink MCP stdio proxy
• Browser CLI and MCP host adapters
• Cavemem Go, JS and Python clients
• Cloud control API and read MCP
SOURCE: JuliusBrussee/caveman @ 99aafe151a1be72be783e662858e8a0955add59f • Public documentation only. No runtime activation or savings claim.
